LB-001.reason: Every sync-peer route except /health (prepare, export-prepare, all sessions/* and export-sessions/* transfer routes) takes client.key. DataSyncPeerClient is the only peer HTTP caller besides the open health probe. It signs every attempt in beforeSending as laravel_peer; Laravel uses the returned PSR request (PendingRequest::runBeforeSendingCallbacks), so each retry gets a fresh nonce. The machine id is the 32-hex LaravelServerIdentity::id(), which matches machine_id_pattern.

LB-002.reason: dashboard.auth requires admin by default and returns 403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN with an i18n message. dashboard.auth:super_admin covers import, restore, sync fetch and the credential writes; dashboard.auth:user covers self-service (api/auth user routes plus the allow-listed web.php elevate/profile/logout). DASHBOARD_LOCAL_DEBUG defaults to off on production hosts (not Windows, not WSL, no desktop).
